title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Music Hall on 1973-12-01

ai_review.summary: Decent 1973 audience recording that’s a bit distant and crowd‑heavy, capturing an average‑energy performance.
ai_review.review: The tape is an audience (aud) source from 1973 that many listeners find listenable despite the loud crowd and slightly distant mix. While some reviewers praise the overall capture, others describe it as disjointed and hard to hear, leading to a mixed impression of both recording and show quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Two strong 4‑star comments offset by a single 2‑star critique; overall the performance is judged average and the audience recording is decent but not crisp.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crowd is loud, music sits a bit distant; some listeners find it disjointed and hard to hear, though most consider it still listenable for an audience tape from 1973.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure or pacing were provided.
